hook.name: MarketMakerHookZeroSeed
hook.description: Protocol-owned market maker hook for a single token/USDC pair that maintains a fixed ask ladder above spot and trailing bid structures below. Charges a flat fee (split between deployer and protocol) on all swaps plus a piecewise-linear zone tax on sells (burned), with LP fees permanently overridden to 0 via beforeSwap delta. No admin keys, no upgrade path.
